## Bottom line

%CAR+ (FC-CAR, release CQA) is driven by three inputs: MOI, transduction timing and vector storage temperature. Three of the four risks that threaten it are HIGH or MEDIUM with controls in place, but the chain has four gaps. The most serious is that a freezer excursion, which the deviation record calls minor, is still linked to the low-%CAR+ engineering runs. PPQ passed on every %CAR+ criterion.

## 1. Drivers, risks and controls

**Process parameters that drive %CAR+** (graph INFLUENCES edges; PPQ-001 criteria in brackets)
- **MOI, target 5.0 TU/cell** (CPP; PPQ crit 1: 4.0–6.0). It also drives VCN and potency.
- **Time from activation to transduction** (CPP; PPQ crit 5: 20–30 h).
- **Vector storage temperature** (KPP; freezer FRZ-80-01/02). **PPQ-001 has no criterion for it**, so PPQ does not test this driver.

**Risks that threaten %CAR+** (failure modes in RA-PFMEA-001 that AFFECT transduction efficiency)

| Risk | Failure mode | Sev/RPN | Class | Mitigations and evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FM-06 | MOI below target (titer over-estimated, vector degraded) | 8 / 128 | HIGH | URS-EBR-007 (vector volume calc), SOP-MFG-104. Evidence: TC-OQ-EBR-04 |
| FM-07 | Vector held above −70 °C (ULT freezer failure) | 8 / 96 | HIGH | URS-ULT-001, URS-ULT-002, URS-EMS-014, SOP-MAT-401. Evidence: see gaps |
| FM-15 | OOS result not flagged at QC release | 10 / 80 | HIGH | URS-LIMS-002, URS-LIMS-003. Evidence: TC-OQ-LIMS-02 and -03 |
| FM-08 | Transduction outside 20–30 h | 6 / 54 | MEDIUM | SOP-MFG-104 only. **No URS, no FRA, no test evidence** |

FM-05 (MOI above target) threatens VCN, not %CAR+. It is mitigated by URS-EBR-007 and URS-EBR-009.

**Requirement-level evidence (currently verified?)**
- **URS-EBR-007** (vector calc): verified. TC-OQ-EBR-04 (SCRIPTED), TX-0083 PASS, 2026-03-17.
- **URS-EBR-009** (reject MOI outside 4.0–6.0): **not verified**. It is HIGH risk (FRA-042, sev 9). CS-EBR-03 traces to it, but no test case verifies CS-EBR-03 or URS-EBR-009.
- **URS-ULT-001** (≤ −70 °C): verified on both freezers. FRZ-80-02 has TX-0091 PASS on 2026-04-24, after CC-26-014 was implemented on 2026-04-23.
- **URS-ULT-002** (high-temperature alarm): verified on both freezers (TX-0039, TX-0092).
- **URS-EMS-014** (escalate unacknowledged critical alarms within 15 min): **stale, not verified**. The last pass (TC-OQ-EMS-04, TX-0070) is 2026-01-20. CC-26-011 changed the escalation configuration in CS-EMS-03 on 2026-03-16, after that pass. The CC says "no re-testing required", but the definition of stale requires a re-test or a documented regression assessment.
- **URS-LIMS-002 and -003**: verified (TX-0074, TX-0075, both PASS, February 2026).
- **FM-08 timing control**: no requirement and no test evidence.

## 2. Measurement and validation

- Method AM-FC-CAR (flow cytometry, validated range 5–90% of CD3+). AMV-FC-CAR-01 is approved. TC-AMV-CAR-01 (TX-0086) passed on 2026-03-20, so the 20% limit sits inside the validated range.
- VCN-PER-CAR = VCN-DDPCR / (FC-CAR/100). I checked this against PPQ26-01: 1.07 / 0.446 ≈ 2.4, which matches the reported 2.39. %CAR+ therefore feeds the VCN-per-CAR+ limit (≤ 5.0).

## 3. PPQ performance (PPQ-001, batches PPQ26-01 to -05)

- **%CAR+ release** (crit 8, ≥ 20%): 44.6, 39.2, 36.1, 38.9, 37.3. All pass; mean ≈ 39.2%.
- **Day-5 IPC CAR+**: 44.6, 39.0, 29.5, 32.0, 35.5. These are at or below release, as expected.
- **Inputs**: MOI 5.0 for all five batches (in range). Transduction timing 21.9–23.7 h (in range). Vector lot LV26-007 (titer 136e6 TU/mL) for batches 01–03; LV26-021 (112e6 TU/mL) for 04–05. Both are stored in FRZ-80-01.
- **Other PPQ results**: VCN-PER-CAR 1.8–2.4 (limit 5.0). Viability and CD3 pass; potency passes.

**Engineering runs with low %CAR+.** ENG26-01, -02 and -03 (May 2026) gave 19.8%, 11.9% and 13.9%. All three used vector lot **LV25-118**, which material_lot still records in **FRZ-80-02**. DEV-26-027 (open) attributes the failures to donor CD3%, and CAPA-26-016 (open) is evaluating a CD3 criterion. The donor explanation is weak. PPQ26-04 had 50.1% CD3 and still reached 38.9% CAR+, and ENG26-03 had 50.9% CD3 and reached 13.9%. The shared factor is the vector lot. This is an unresolved hypothesis, not a finding.

**Freezer excursion (DEV-26-021, closed 2026-05-12, rated MAJOR, "low risk").** The historian for FRZ8002 shows:
- Above −70 °C from 20 Apr 04:00 to 23 Apr 12:00 (about 81 h).
- Peak −10 °C at 23 Apr 10:00.
- The deviation records the maximum as "approx −36 °C" and says the contents were moved to FRZ-80-01 at 15:30 on 20 April. The impact assessment relies on that figure.
- The EMS alarm (EV-26-0009) was raised at 03:20 on 20 April and acknowledged at 14:40, an 11 h 20 min lag. No escalation event is recorded.
- The deviation says the vector lots were relocated, but LV25-118 is still listed in FRZ-80-02. The trace links connect the deviation to FRZ-80-02 only, not to any lot.

So the impact assessment appears to rest on an incorrect temperature, and it is unresolved whether LV25-118 was affected.

content.text:
## Bottom line

%CAR+ (FC-CAR, release CQA) is driven by three inputs: MOI, transduction timing and vector storage temperature. Three of the four risks that threaten it are HIGH or MEDIUM with controls in place, but the chain has four gaps. The most serious is that a freezer excursion, which the deviation record calls minor, is still linked to the low-%CAR+ engineering runs. PPQ passed on every %CAR+ criterion.

## 1. Drivers, risks and controls

**Process parameters that drive %CAR+** (graph INFLUENCES edges; PPQ-001 criteria in brackets)
- **MOI, target 5.0 TU/cell** (CPP; PPQ crit 1: 4.0–6.0). It also drives VCN and potency.
- **Time from activation to transduction** (CPP; PPQ crit 5: 20–30 h).
- **Vector storage temperature** (KPP; freezer FRZ-80-01/02). **PPQ-001 has no criterion for it**, so PPQ does not test this driver.

**Risks that threaten %CAR+** (failure modes in RA-PFMEA-001 that AFFECT transduction efficiency)

| Risk | Failure mode | Sev/RPN | Class | Mitigations and evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FM-06 | MOI below target (titer over-estimated, vector degraded) | 8 / 128 | HIGH | URS-EBR-007 (vector volume calc), SOP-MFG-104. Evidence: TC-OQ-EBR-04 |
| FM-07 | Vector held above −70 °C (ULT freezer failure) | 8 / 96 | HIGH | URS-ULT-001, URS-ULT-002, URS-EMS-014, SOP-MAT-401. Evidence: see gaps |
| FM-15 | OOS result not flagged at QC release | 10 / 80 | HIGH | URS-LIMS-002, URS-LIMS-003. Evidence: TC-OQ-LIMS-02 and -03 |
| FM-08 | Transduction outside 20–30 h | 6 / 54 | MEDIUM | SOP-MFG-104 only. **No URS, no FRA, no test evidence** |

FM-05 (MOI above target) threatens VCN, not %CAR+. It is mitigated by URS-EBR-007 and URS-EBR-009.

**Requirement-level evidence (currently verified?)**
- **URS-EBR-007** (vector calc): verified. TC-OQ-EBR-04 (SCRIPTED), TX-0083 PASS, 2026-03-17.
- **URS-EBR-009** (reject MOI outside 4.0–6.0): **not verified**. It is HIGH risk (FRA-042, sev 9). CS-EBR-03 traces to it, but no test case verifies CS-EBR-03 or URS-EBR-009.
- **URS-ULT-001** (≤ −70 °C): verified on both freezers. FRZ-80-02 has TX-0091 PASS on 2026-04-24, after CC-26-014 was implemented on 2026-04-23.
- **URS-ULT-002** (high-temperature alarm): verified on both freezers (TX-0039, TX-0092).
- **URS-EMS-014** (escalate unacknowledged critical alarms within 15 min): **stale, not verified**. The last pass (TC-OQ-EMS-04, TX-0070) is 2026-01-20. CC-26-011 changed the escalation configuration in CS-EMS-03 on 2026-03-16, after that pass. The CC says "no re-testing required", but the definition of stale requires a re-test or a documented regression assessment.
- **URS-LIMS-002 and -003**: verified (TX-0074, TX-0075, both PASS, February 2026).
- **FM-08 timing control**: no requirement and no test evidence.

## 2. Measurement and validation

- Method AM-FC-CAR (flow cytometry, validated range 5–90% of CD3+). AMV-FC-CAR-01 is approved. TC-AMV-CAR-01 (TX-0086) passed on 2026-03-20, so the 20% limit sits inside the validated range.
- VCN-PER-CAR = VCN-DDPCR / (FC-CAR/100). I checked this against PPQ26-01: 1.07 / 0.446 ≈ 2.4, which matches the reported 2.39. %CAR+ therefore feeds the VCN-per-CAR+ limit (≤ 5.0).

## 3. PPQ performance (PPQ-001, batches PPQ26-01 to -05)

- **%CAR+ release** (crit 8, ≥ 20%): 44.6, 39.2, 36.1, 38.9, 37.3. All pass; mean ≈ 39.2%.
- **Day-5 IPC CAR+**: 44.6, 39.0, 29.5, 32.0, 35.5. These are at or below release, as expected.
- **Inputs**: MOI 5.0 for all five batches (in range). Transduction timing 21.9–23.7 h (in range). Vector lot LV26-007 (titer 136e6 TU/mL) for batches 01–03; LV26-021 (112e6 TU/mL) for 04–05. Both are stored in FRZ-80-01.
- **Other PPQ results**: VCN-PER-CAR 1.8–2.4 (limit 5.0). Viability and CD3 pass; potency passes.

## 4. Deviations, CAPA and change control

**Engineering runs with low %CAR+.** ENG26-01, -02 and -03 (May 2026) gave 19.8%, 11.9% and 13.9%. All three used vector lot **LV25-118**, which material_lot still records in **FRZ-80-02**. DEV-26-027 (open) attributes the failures to donor CD3%, and CAPA-26-016 (open) is evaluating a CD3 criterion. The donor explanation is weak. PPQ26-04 had 50.1% CD3 and still reached 38.9% CAR+, and ENG26-03 had 50.9% CD3 and reached 13.9%. The shared factor is the vector lot. This is an unresolved hypothesis, not a finding.

**Freezer excursion (DEV-26-021, closed 2026-05-12, rated MAJOR, "low risk").** The historian for FRZ8002 shows:
- Above −70 °C from 20 Apr 04:00 to 23 Apr 12:00 (about 81 h).
- Peak −10 °C at 23 Apr 10:00.
- The deviation records the maximum as "approx −36 °C" and says the contents were moved to FRZ-80-01 at 15:30 on 20 April. The impact assessment relies on that figure.
- The EMS alarm (EV-26-0009) was raised at 03:20 on 20 April and acknowledged at 14:40, an 11 h 20 min lag. No escalation event is recorded.
- The deviation says the vector lots were relocated, but LV25-118 is still listed in FRZ-80-02. The trace links connect the deviation to FRZ-80-02 only, not to any lot.

So the impact assessment appears to rest on an incorrect temperature, and it is unresolved whether LV25-118 was affected.

**Change control CC-26-022 (proposed, impact assessment).** It would raise target MOI from 5.0 to 8.0 TU/cell to improve %CAR+. The impact assessment lists only SOP-MFG-104. It does not address URS-EBR-009 (4.0–6.0 TU/cell reject rule), PPQ-001 crit 1, or FRA-042. Those would all have to change.
